item.title: A half-time speech, a retaken penalty - and a win to save Carrick's job?

item.title: Emery takes positives, but Villa 'have work to do' to reach Barca level

item.title: We don't need to save anyone's job, says Man Utd captain Fernandes
item.description: Bruno Fernandes says Manchester United's players "don't need to save anyone's job" after their improbable comeback win against Roma.

item.title: Man Utd beat Roma - the other great Champions League comebacks
item.description: Manchester United come from two goals down to beat Roma 3-2 - but what are the other best fightbacks in Champions League history?

item.title: Football world mourns Tenerife striker De Miguel

item.title: Saliba's back for Arsenal - how does Arteta solve his defensive dilemma?
item.description: William Saliba returning to first-team training before Arsenal's game with Slavia Prague in the Champions League is a huge boost for the club but now presents Mikel Arteta with a selection headache.

item.title: West Ham approach Parker after sacking boss Nuno
item.description: West Ham United sack head coach Nuno Espirito Santo and are said to be in talks with Scott Parker as his replacement.

item.title: Man Utd eye Man City's Ait-Nouri - Wednesday's gossip

item.title: Everton hold off Newcastle to move into seventh

item.title: Every goal from the Women's Super League - matchweek eight

item.title: Arsenal move clear at the top with a rare win at Liverpool
